UNI-T UT61E+ x1 or separately admitted equivalent static reference
currentStagingDelta.interpretation: This is an execution-staging contraction, not a rejection of the broader first-order portfolio. PortfolioApproved != RequiredBeforeFirstRealityContact.

nonClaims: does not claim historical prices are current
does not claim any item is currently in stock
does not claim no purchase happened outside Ordivon after 2026-08-27
does not make the full first-order portfolio a prerequisite for E0-B
does not erase or rewrite the exact historical packet

procurementEffects.afterArrival: Use the E0-B arrival/re-entry contract for first-contact carriers; use equivalent item-specific identity/fitness/Agent-realizability receipts for the rest of the portfolio.
beforeAnyPayment: current site facts where operation safety depends on them

reopenRules: A fresh transaction/payment/order/arrival receipt replaces UNKNOWN transaction standing only for the exact affected objects.
A major price/availability change may reopen item selection if it crosses the original capability/cost knee; do not preserve a SKU merely to match history.
A new concrete consumer may promote a currently deferred/JIT carrier or delete a previously approved item from an execution stage.
Do not run another category-completeness survey without a concrete missing capability or repeated consumer failure.
retainedStructuralStanding: The first-order portfolio is capability-pressure based rather than conventional lab checklist completion.
Exact/load-bearing capital, specification-bounded commodity stock, site-measured infrastructure and JIT-after-E0 remain distinct procurement classes.
Arrival is not capability; object identity, attachment/provider generation, fitness, safety and experiment admission remain post-delivery obligations.
Breadboard is the reversible exploration substrate; perfboard/protoboard is the stabilized intermediate substrate; custom PCB remains pressure-driven.

SDS824X HD and AD3 remain complementary long-horizon observation/stimulus carriers in the historical full first-order portfolio; this does not make both deletion-essential for the first Reality-contact experiment.
E1 target-specific hardware remains JIT rather than first-order by default.
Direct exhaust is a site-realized capability and should not be replaced by a filtration SKU merely for procurement completeness.

truthBoundary.currentTransactionReality: UNKNOWN absent a fresh payment/order/arrival/owner receipt. Lack of a newer Ordivon receipt is not evidence that no off-surface purchase occurred.
truthBoundary.lastCapturedPurchaseEffect: The 2026-08-27 checkout-currentness receipt explicitly states PURCHASE NOT YET EXECUTED.
truthBoundary.priceStockSellerCurrentness: STALE_BY_DATE. Every 2026-08-27 price, stock, seller, warranty/accessory and cart observation remains historical evidence only and must be re-observed immediately before any payment.
truthBoundary.siteFacts: Previously recorded site/direct-exhaust facts remain historical owner evidence and should be re-observed if the physical site changed or if a safety-sensitive operation depends on them.
